description: The plot illustrates how the number of “Shared Experts for Two Samples” varies with “Sample Token Count” for six task categories (Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, Math). The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and uses a logarithmic base-2 scale with tick labels from \(2^9\) to \(2^{20}\) at every power of two. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples,” appears linear, and spans roughly from about 2.0 up to about 6.0 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.5 increments. The Intent series is an orange solid line with no markers, rising from about 3.8 at \(2^9\) to about 6.0 at \(2^{20}\), with a dip near \(2^{11}\) (about 3.9) and then increasing to around 5.5–5.6 by \(2^{13}\)–\(2^{15}\) and approaching ~6.0 from about \(2^{18}\) onward. The Summary series is a blue solid line, increasing from about 1.9 at \(2^9\) to about 6.0 at \(2^{20}\), with a sharp rise to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), a small drop around \(2^{12}\) (~4.5), then climbing past ~5.4 at \(2^{14}\) and reaching ~5.9–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Law series is a yellow/gold solid line, starting near 3.6 at \(2^9\) and ending near 6.0 at \(2^{20}\), rising to about 5.1 at \(2^{11}\), dipping around \(2^{12}\) (~4.6), then increasing to about 5.6–5.8 around \(2^{13}\)–\(2^{14}\) and staying near ~5.9–6.0 from roughly \(2^{17}\) onward. The Translation series is a purple solid line, beginning around 5.1 at \(2^9\) and ending just under or around 6.0 at \(2^{20}\), dipping to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), then rising to about 5.6 at \(2^{12}\) and gradually increasing to ~5.9–6.0 by \(2^{17}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Code series is a gray solid line, starting near 1.9 at \(2^9\) and increasing to about 5.8 at \(2^{20}\), with a gradual rise to ~3.1 at \(2^{12}\), a local peak near \(2^{13}\) (~3.7), a drop at \(2^{14}\) (~3.1), then a steady climb through ~4.2 at \(2^{15}\), ~4.8 at \(2^{16}\), and ~5.3–5.7 from \(2^{17}\) to \(2^{19}\). The Math series is a green solid line, rising from about 3.8 at \(2^9\) to about 6.0 at \(2^{20}\), increasing fairly steadily through ~4.7 at \(2^{11}\), ~5.0 at \(2^{12}\), ~5.3 at \(2^{13}\), and reaching ~5.9–6.0 by about \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\), with a slight dip around \(2^{19}\) (just under ~5.9).
